noProject.body: Select or create a project to run its environment services.

business.title: Open {{project}}
business.body: One click starts everything the project needs and opens your product's screen. What runs underneath is the team's business.
business.unknownService: We don't know yet which service of this project serves the customer's screen. Once the team marks it, the button shows up here — we won't open some other service instead.
business.credentials: This project has no demo credentials on file. When it does, they appear here so you can sign in and try it.

services.title: Detected services
services.empty: No services detected in this project yet.
services.stackUnavailable: Stack not declared by the project
services.hostDependencies: Observed external process; it hosts this screen.
services.managedDependencies: Launcher-managed target; target-specific dependencies are not declared by the manifest.

logs.title: Environment logs
logs.label: Real-time logs
logs.empty: No log lines — start a service to see the streaming.

credentials.title: Demo credentials
credentials.backendOnly: No demo credentials were provided for this project. The interface does not store or reveal credentials on its own.

guide.poseidon:
Open the frontend (dev) URL and check the console for errors
Start the Backend API and watch the health check in the logs
Sign in with the demo credentials
guide.generic:
Start all services and watch the logs
Open the main HTTP service URL
Check the health checks before reporting issues

cleanup.title: Clean up environment
cleanup.body: This stops all project services and cleans up the run environment. Continue?

localMode.title: Local mode
localMode.body: In local mode everything runs on this computer: you start the Launcher from the shortcut, it brings up the local Host/Runner, picks a port and opens the browser — no IDE required.
localMode.actionsNote: To manage the environment, use the Restart and Stop actions available above, on each service.
localMode.shortcut: Instruction: to open this environment outside the app, use the "Harness Poseidon Launcher" shortcut in the system applications menu.
